$comment: Explicit exceptions of the parity check (scripts/compare-dist.cjs). Every entry names the profiles and mode it applies to, the routes ("*" means every route of the profile, minus exceptRoutes), the exact node or attribute, the expected before/after and how many matches each route must produce. A rule that matches a different number of times fails the check.

rules.name: defer
rules.reason: The only agreed deviation of release A (plan, section 2): the shared layout loads webflow.js with defer on every page; the legacy offer page was the one page without it.
